entries.notes: Voice recipe narrator_a: Kokoro style mix {'am_michael': 0.7, 'bm_lewis': 0.3}, speed 0.88, lang en-us. Primary candidate. Mastering: soxr resample to 44.1 kHz, chain 'highpass=f=70,equalizer=f=180:t=q:w=1.0:g=1.0,equalizer=f=3500:t=q:w=1.2:g=1.0,acompressor=threshold=-22dB:ratio=2.2:attack=12:release=180:makeup=1', two-pass loudnorm to -18 LUFS / -1.5 dBTP. Measured on the delivered file: integrated -18.0 LUFS, true peak -1.2 dBTP, LRA 2.1 LU, 96 kbps mono. Slides joined with 1.1 s gaps. Bus 'Voice' is proposed (not in default_bus_layout.tres yet).
